title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Booked-Day Fees: Posting a Booked Day
content:
The Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program prices the day fee of the most recent drop-in booking request of an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year, and only of such an enrollment. Only requests that are received or completed count, the latest being taken by the time each was received; a declined or cancelled request is never priced. A booked day's fee is posted before the next booking request is received. An enrollment with no drop-in booking request has no booked-day fee to price. A booking on an enrollment of any other school year is charged the drop-in day fee, the holiday camp day fee or the early-release day fee, as the program's day-fee rules set them for that year.

**Booking conditions.** Under the program's booking conditions:

- each drop-in day is still charged the drop-in day fee;
- a holiday camp day may still be booked only on a plan with holiday camp access, and is still charged the holiday camp day fee;
- an early-release afternoon is still covered without any fee when the plan includes early-release afternoons; otherwise a booked early-release afternoon is still charged the early-release day fee.

**Posting.** Posting books one booked-day fee entry on the enrollment's billing history for the booked day of care and its day type, dated the day it is posted. The enrollment's balance due goes up by the fee, and the booked day then shows in the billing history.

## Calling `post_booked_day_fee_4f9449e5`

The tool is used by the agent: the agent unlocks `post_booked_day_fee_4f9449e5` and then calls it. Each call books one day fee entry.

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `care_enrollment_id` | the Extended Day enrollment reference number the day is booked on, as returned by the Extended Day enrollment lookup | identifier |
| `service_date` | the booked day of care, exactly as the requested date shown on the drop-in booking request in the enrollment's request lookup | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `day_type` | how the day is booked | `drop_in_day` (a drop-in day of care outside the plan's schedule), `holiday_camp_day` (a district holiday camp day), `early_release_day` (an early-release afternoon); `not_applicable` is never a booked day and a call carrying it is refused |
| `fee_amount` | the fee in US dollars | a positive amount with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, half a cent rounding up; zero or negative amounts are not accepted |

**Successful return.** The tool returns a confirmation sentence naming the new day fee entry's reference number (text beginning `cdf_`), the enrollment reference number, the booked day (YYYY-MM-DD), the day type, the fee in dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Its presence means the day is booked and charged.

**Errors.** A sentence beginning "Error:" means nothing was booked. The tool returns one for a day type outside the three listed, for a fee that is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places, for a booked day not written YYYY-MM-DD, or when no Extended Day enrollment has the reference number given.
